title: Building Guardrails for Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Literature review of existing research on detecting gender bias and evaluating mitigation techniques such as model adaptation (e.g., DAMA), text-based preambles, and prompt engineering.
Literature review of studies that address cultural bias through methodologies like fine-tuning models on culturally relevant data and using cultural prompting.

Literature review of research focused on identifying and quantifying instances of social bias in sensitive applications (like job and college admissions screening) and debiasing via the Stereotype Content Model.

Literature review of studies that examine political bias (alongside race, gender, and religion) in LLMs by collecting and analyzing multiple answers to the same questions to account for response randomness.
